$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package unit.grammar.haxe. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-KIT-FORK-STARTS-RAW
arms.note: the fork baseline starts from the compiled defaults, so the six body policies and the curly blanks a config document re-baselines stay at their raw values

arms.name: M-KIT-RAW-STARTS-FORK
arms.note: the raw baseline starts from the config loader, so the compiled defaults arrive already re-baselined to the fork's values

arms.name: M-KIT-STRICT-NO-REFUSAL
arms.note: a document naming a setting the loader does not act on loads silently, as the plain loader does

arms.name: M-FIXTURE-TYPED-OPTIONS-IGNORED
arms.note: a typed write copies the compiled defaults instead of the options it was handed, so no typed knob reaches the writer

arms.name: M-FIXTURE-TYPED-OPTIONS-ALIASED
arms.note: a typed write switches finalNewline off on the caller's own options object instead of on a copy

arms.name: M-FIXTURE-JSON-LENIENT
arms.note: a fixture write handed a hxformat.json document loads it as the plain loader does, so a key the loader ignores leaves the test writing the default
